operators.name: custom_embedding
semantics: Performs embedding lookup: output[b, s, :] = weight[indices[b, s], :].
Input indices are int64 on CPU; weight is float32 on CPU; the output is float32 on CUDA 0.
The function internally transfers data to CUDA and launches a kernel to copy embeddings.
Returns a new CUDA tensor with shape [batch, seq_len, embedding_dim] and same batch/seq as indices.

operators.name: custom_layer_norm
semantics: Computes LayerNorm over the last dimension of size normalized_dim.
mean = mean(input, dim=-1, keepdim=True); var = var(input, dim=-1, unbiased=False, keepdim=True).
If elementwise_affine is True and weight/bias are not None, output = output * weight + bias.
If weight or bias is None, the corresponding affine term is skipped.
The input and output are float32 CUDA tensors; weight and bias are float32 CPU tensors and are moved to CUDA internally.
Returns a new CUDA tensor with the same shape as input.
Embedding lookup: output[b, s, :] = weight[indices[b, s], :].
Input indices int64 CPU, weight float32 CPU, output float32 CUDA.
No padding or special index handling; assumes all indices within [0, vocab_size-1].
LayerNorm over the last dimension of size 32.
Mean and variance computed over the last dimension for each position.
If elementwise_affine, multiply by norm.weight and add norm.bias.
Returns the output of LayerNorm as a float32 CUDA tensor with shape [64, 5120, 32].
